sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder-Q4_K_M-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder - Q4_K_M Q4_K_M GGUF of CCORE's original FP16 checkpoint, quantized independently from its full-precision export. The upstream checkpoint has 4,539,265,536 parameters including vision; this text GGUF has 4,205,751,296 parameters. The unchanged upstream BF16 vision projector is included. This is a community quantization of CCORE's fine-tune, not an official Qwen or CCORE ...

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B-GLB-3D-Coder: Run This Local Model for Game Assets
sources.snippet: A guide to Qwen3.5-4B-GLB-3D-Coder, a local GGUF model that writes Three.js scenes and exports GLB assets for Godot game projects.
